questions.question: In an algebraic expression, parts separated by + or - signs are called:
questions.explanation: Terms are the parts of an expression connected by + or - signs

questions.question: In the term 5xy, the numerical coefficient is:
questions.explanation: The numerical coefficient is the constant number multiplying the variables in a term

questions.question: Quantities multiplied together to form a term are called its:
questions.explanation: Factors are the quantities that multiply together to make up a term

questions.question: Terms having the same algebraic factors (same variables with same powers) are called:
questions.explanation: Like terms have identical variables raised to identical powers; only their coefficients may differ

questions.question: True or False: 3x² and 3x are like terms.
questions.explanation: 3x² and 3x have different powers of x, so they are unlike terms

questions.question: Terms with different algebraic factors are called:
questions.explanation: Unlike terms have different variables or different powers of variables

questions.question: While adding algebraic expressions, we combine:
questions.explanation: Only like terms can be added or subtracted by combining their coefficients

questions.question: True or False: Unlike terms can be combined into a single term by addition.
questions.explanation: Unlike terms cannot be combined; they remain separate terms in the result

questions.question: Finding the value of an algebraic expression involves:
questions.explanation: The value of an expression is found by substituting numerical values in place of its variables

questions.question: True or False: The value of an expression can change depending on the value assigned to its variable.
questions.explanation: Since expressions contain variables, their value depends on the values substituted for those variables
